examName: Developing AI Apps and Agents on Azure
note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for AI-103, 'Skills measured as of April 16, 2026'. This is the first five-domain exam in the catalogue; three of its domains share a 10-15% band, so the paper carries 8 questions in each of them. Always check learn.microsoft.com for the current official breakdown before your exam, as Microsoft periodically revises exam blueprints.

domains.name: Plan and manage an Azure AI solution
subtopics: Choose an appropriate model for each task, including large, small, and multimodal models and Foundry Tools
Choose the appropriate Foundry services for generation, grounding, vector search, agent workflows, and multimodal processing
Choose an appropriate method for retrieval and indexing
Choose memory, tool, and knowledge integration services for agent solutions
Design Azure infrastructure for AI apps and configure model and agent deployments
Integrate Foundry projects with CI/CD pipelines
Manage quotas, scaling, rate limits, and cost footprints for model and agent workloads
Monitor model performance, drift, safety events, grounding quality, and search index health
Configure security including managed identity, private networking, keyless credentials, and role policies
Configure safety filters, guardrails, evaluators, trace logging, provenance, and agent oversight modes

domains.name: Implement generative AI and agentic solutions
subtopics: Deploy and consume large, small, code, and multimodal models
Implement retrieval-augmented generation in an application
Design workflows, tool-augmented flows, and multistep reasoning pipelines
Evaluate models and apps for fabrications, relevance, quality, and safety
Integrate generative workflows using Foundry SDKs and connect an application to a Foundry project
Define agent roles, goals, conversation tracking, and tool schemas
Build agents that integrate retrieval, function calling, and conversation memory
Integrate agent tools including APIs, knowledge stores, search, and custom functions
Implement orchestrated multi-agent solutions and approval flow controls
Tune generation behaviour, implement self-critique loops, and set up tracing and token analytics

domains.name: Implement computer vision solutions
subtopics: Generate images and videos from text prompts and reference media
Configure image-editing workflows including inpainting and mask-based edits
Analyse visual context by using multimodal models and produce captions
Implement question answering grounded in visual evidence
Generate alt text and extended descriptions aligned to accessibility guidelines
Configure single-task and pro-mode Content Understanding pipelines
Implement video analysis workflows and identify objects and regions
Filter unsafe visual content and mitigate indirect prompt injection embedded in images
Enforce visual policy rules such as watermarking and prohibited symbol detection

domains.name: Implement text analysis solutions
subtopics: Extract entities, topics, summaries, and structured JSON by using generative prompting and Foundry Tools
Configure detection of sentiment, tone, safety issues, and sensitive content
Translate text by using Azure Translator in Foundry Tools or LLM-powered translation flows
Customise language model outputs for domain tasks such as compliance summarisation
Convert speech to text and text to speech for agentic interactions
Integrate speech as an agent modality, including custom speech models
Enable multimodal reasoning from audio inputs
Translate speech into other languages by using language models and Foundry Tools

domains.name: Implement information extraction solutions
subtopics: Ingest and index documents, images, audio, and video
Configure semantic search, hybrid search, and vector search for grounding
Implement enrichment by using custom or built-in skills for text, images, and layout
Configure RAG ingestion flow, including documents and optical character recognition
Connect retrieval pipelines directly to workflows and agent tools
Extract information by using multimodal pipelines combining OCR, layout analysis, and field extraction
Produce clean, grounded representations for agents and RAG by using Content Understanding
Implement analyzers generating structured or markdown outputs for downstream reasoning
